sources.snippet: This is based on the implementation of Qwen3.5-0.8B found here. This repository contains scripts for optimized on-device export suitable to run on Qualcomm® devices. More details on model performance across various devices, can be found here. Qualcomm AI Hub Models uses Qualcomm AI Hub Workbench to compile, profile, and evaluate this model.

sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-0.8B Ultra‑compact 0.8B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for edge deployment. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.
